messages:
Elaine: Quick flag — our KPI dashboard shows a 48% jump in MQLs for the APAC launch cohort starting 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. Can someone confirm source? https://dash.redwood.ai/kpi?view=launch-cohort :eyes:

growth-bot: Automated alert: MQLs +48% vs 7-day baseline; CPL -12%. Top referral=partner-labs, traffic spike at 02:07 UTC. (report id: gb-9843)

Mike: I see the same in GA. Lots of sessions with utm_source=partner-labs and utm_campaign=mar-launch-aps. Could be the partners list push we did Saturday night.

Sophia: Hm — email send to partners was A/B with two subject lines. Did we accidentally send to the broader list?

James: Quick SQL check I ran: ```SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE received_at >= '2026-03-19' AND utm_source='partner-labs'; -- returned 1274``` Might be legit volume but timing looks like a single bulk import or batch hit.

Elaine: Good catch. Can we validate ingestion? If this is a duplicate import into SFDC, our MQLs will be polluted for the weekly KPI.

analytics-bot: SFDC import logs: import_2026_03_19_0205.csv processed by ops@partners at 02:05 UTC, 1,280 rows. No parsing errors.

Mike: That lines up. 1,280 imported ≈ 1,274 leads SQL returned. Need to check if those leads were already in the system (dedupe).

Sophia: If they were re-imported, attribution will skew toward partner-labs. We should mark the import as "partner-batch" in the dashboard and exclude duplicates from the MQL baseline for the weekly review.

James: Agree. Quick next steps: 1) analytics to run dedupe check (email / phone), 2) ops to confirm whether import was a resend, 3) update dashboard filters and recalc MQL baseline before Friday KPI readout.

Elaine: Can someone pull the raw GA sessions for 02:00-03:00 UTC and the SFDC import file? I want to see overlap and UTM consistency.

analytics-bot: Export request queued: ga_sessions_2026-03-19_0200-0300.csv (ETA 8m).

Mike: I can own dedupe query and share the quick diff by 14:30 UTC.

Sophia: I'll ping ops to confirm whether partners re-sent the CSV. If they did, we need a rollup note for the weekly KPI doc to avoid misattribution.

Elaine: Perfect. If we confirm duplicate import, we'll exclude these rows from public KPI slides and add an appendix note. If it's a true spike, we'll dig into messaging impact and webinar signups. Either way — quick sync at 15:30 UTC? 10 minutes.

James: 15:30 UTC works for me. I'll bring the dedupe snippet and sample rows.

Mike: +1

Sophia: +1 :thumbsup:

growth-bot: Scheduled: "KPI spike triage" 2026-03-19 15:30 UTC — calendar invites sent to participants.
